ledger.x: 4000 BCE: the Dapenkeng culture appears on the coasts of Taiwan and the Penghu islands and the Fujian coast ("between 4000 and 3000 BC").

3000 BCE: the Dapenkeng culture ends ("between 4000 and 3000 BC"); about 2500 BC it "developed into locally differentiated cultures throughout Taiwan", so the island is empty for five centuries on these pages.

certainty.note: Known from coastal sites; no frontier is recorded.
